text: UFC boss Dana White has reportedly turned down President Trump's offer to become White House press secretary, though a White House aide suggests the offer was a joke.
Bernie Sanders to Democrats: "We cannot spend all of our time investigating Trump."

MAGA voters are already looking to 2028, and two names keep coming up as Trump's successor: Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

Supporters at a rally in Bangor, Maine split between Rubio's experience and Vance as the natural heir.

Accepting the mandate, Gadi Eisenkot says he will lead the formation of a national emergency government, admitting "No one will be able to meet all the commitments they have given. We will all be required to compromise."
Update: Egypt's Health Ministry confirms at least 4 dead and 88 injured after a passenger train derailed in Giza province.
Gadi Eisenkot has officially received the mandate to form Israel's next government, at a ceremony with President Isaac Herzog at the President's House.
🚨 New footage from the Strait of Hormuz shows ships burning after IRGC missile strikes, while NASA FIRMS satellite data flagged two more possible tankers on fire in the western part of the strait.
Putin has ordered the seizure of tobacco manufacturing assets in Russia worth 4 billion, as tensions with Japan over the disputed northern islands keep rising.
Myanmar's People's Defense Forces hit Burmese army positions with drones, dropping improvised PVC bombs. Several impacts are visible in the footage.
Shas party leader Aryeh Deri has resigned from the Israeli Knesset after a sharp drop in support for his party.
🚨 The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant has lost all off site power once again, leaving reactor cooling dependent on emergency diesel generators, the IAEA says.
🚨 The House is poised to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth next week after the midterm defeat, Axios reports.
Iraq has sentenced former Salah al Din governor Ammar Jabr Khalil to 14 years in prison in absentia.
China's newest aircraft carrier Fujian (CV 18) sails the South China Sea with J 15T carrier fighters lined up on its flight deck.

President Trump says the midterm results set America back, pointing to a $3 trillion one day drop in stock market value.

He says the market soared under his leadership and promises the country will come back "BIGGER AND STRONGER THAN EVER BEFORE!"
Major US military reinforcements keep flowing toward the Middle East, with 6 more military cargo aircraft on their way to the region.

German police arrested three people in Berlin after a man climbed the 30 metre flagpole outside the Reichstag, took down the German flag and raised a Palestinian flag.

Two accomplices filmed the climb. All three are suspected of insulting state symbols.
Israel's ambassador to Germany, Ron Prosor, says the Palestinian flag is flown around the world "as a symbol of hatred for Israel" rather than in support of Palestinians.

New Sentinel 2 imagery shows visible changes at Pumping Station No. 8 on Saudi Arabia's East West oil pipeline.

A link to yesterday's Houthi claimed strikes is not yet confirmed.

🚨 BREAKING: The Houthis claim a missile and drone attack on Saudi Arabia.

Spokesman Yahya Saree says they hit King Khalid International Airport, Aramco storage tanks and the financial district in Riyadh, plus Aramco facilities in Abqaiq, sparking fires.
